name: Análisis de Cadena de Correferencia
description: Examina correferencia resolución chains para identificar generado por IA text through abnormal entity tracking and pronominal reference patrones.
useCase: Detección de texto IA mediante cadenas de referencia de entidades inconsistentes o simplificadas
mechanism: Constructs correferencia chains linking mentions of the same entity throughout the text (pronombres, noun phrases, proper names). generado por IA text often shows shorter correferencia chains, less complex reference resolucións, and occasional entity confusion—where referents are ambiguously or incorrectly resolved. The method mide chain length distribución, referential distance, and chain branching complexity.
source: Dugan, L. et al. (2024) - RAID: A Shared Benchmark for Robust Evaluation of Machine-Generated Text Detectors, ACL
algorithm: Coreference Resolution + Chain Statistics + Anomaly Scoring
parameters: Modelo: neural correferencia resolver, Min chain length: 2 mentions, Metrics: chain density, avg distance, branching factor, Text min: 200 words
strengths:
• Captures deep discourse-level coherencia
• Effective on long-form narratives and essays
• Detecta subtle entity tracking failures
• Orthogonal to surface-level características
limitations:
• Computacionalmente costoso for long texts
• Coreference resolución itself is imperfect
• Short texts yield too few chains for análisis
• Performance depends on correferencia model quality

references.title: Dugan, L. et al. (2024). RAID: A Shared Benchmark for Robust Evaluation of Machine-Generated Text Detectors. ACL.
Clark, K. & Manning, C. D. (2016). Deep Reinforcement Learning for Mention-Ranking Coreference Models. EMNLP.
Pu, J. et al. (2023). On the Zero-Shot Generalization of Machine-Generated Text Detectors. EMNLP Findings.
